pictures.deviceText: Made here, privately and for free, even offline. Each is checked here first: pictures showing nudity, sex or self-harm are refused.
pictures.suggestiveText: Skimpy swimwear and underwear, and suggestive poses, too. Nudity and sex are always refused.
pictures.hateText: Nazi, terrorist and other extremist symbols and propaganda. Turn it off for history, teaching or reporting.
pictures.violenceText: Gore, mutilation, severe injuries and dead bodies. Battles and fights without them are allowed.
